author: Sana Khan
text: Welcome everyone to the new joiners chat channel! Feel free to ask any onboarding questions here.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Hi Sana! Thanks for setting this up. How do I get badge access to the QC testing wing?

author: Sana Khan
text: You will need to complete the gowning qualification module in LMS first, then security will activate your badge.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Great, working through the online training modules right now.

author: Sana Khan
text: Also check the onboarding checklist in ONB-001 on SharePoint for week 1 priorities.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Yes, I am reading through the Quality Manual and SOP-001 today.

author: Sana Khan
text: Let me know if you want to grab lunch around 12:30 with the QA analysts.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Sounds great! See you at 12:30 in the cafeteria.

author: Sana Khan
text: Remember to log your reading completion signatures in the training tracker.

author: Rahul Verma
text: All signed and submitted for day 1!
